data.name: FetchHound
data.description: From human-canine to human-robot object search: teaching a quadruped a dog-like social attention policy. Reconstructs 3D gaze and attention from multi-camera dog video, then trains closed-loop policies (PyTorch MLP/LSTM/Transformer) via learning from demonstration, evaluated on Spot in simulation. Preliminary results presented at the ICRA 2026 Learning-HRI workshop.

data.name: UMBRA: Multi-Robot Shadow Art
data.description: A multi-robot shadow performance system supported by the National Endowment for the Arts. A fleet of SO-101 arms holds props under a single light to cast designed silhouettes: analytic pose solving, prop assignment, 5-DOF IK in MuJoCo, CMA-ES + JAX trajectory optimization, and a Next.js + FastAPI fleet-control design studio, deployed to real hardware.
